subject: hud_panel_small
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production asset for the strict overhead pixel-art game Border Defenders.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED MASTER STYLE REFERENCE v002, style/palette only, NOT an edit target. Match its restrained gritty Danube quarantine-line pixel art.
Palette anchors: shadow #1F292C, river deep #17444C, shallow #2D5C5D, wet mud #5A4633, dry soil #816445, grass #4B5538, olive #636B44, concrete #939486, steel #5A615D, rust #7F4833, bone #C1B19E, amber #C18A3E. Use only the relevant material ramp, roughly 3-5 shades. Keep terrain less contrasted than props. Flat square pixel clusters; no blur, antialiasing, photographic texture, fine noise, isometric geometry or perspective. View exactly vertically down. No long baked shadows. No labels, captions, watermark, board borders, grid lines, mockup, montage or additional assets.
Subject: A horizontal 2:1 small HUD panel. Narrow riveted muted steel frame with clipped pixel corners, simple charcoal inner fill. Interior completely empty and quiet.
This is a production pixel-art UI asset for a 128x64 logical canvas. Match master military material palette. Every edge is a square pixel step; broad clean color fields, no microtexture, dirt speckle or beveled photographic lighting. No text, numerals, watermark, mockup or extra assets. Leave panel/button centers dark solid opaque, with no decoration where live text goes.
Output just ONE asset on perfectly uniform solid MAGENTA #FF00FF background, with magenta in icon gaps. The background will be removed by chroma key. No checkerboard, magenta spill, shadows or glow. Fill 90% of the canvas with the complete object and keep it centered.
method: nearest-neighbor; paired seam-edge blend before palette mapping; no dithering; binary alpha threshold 128
